legend: There are n animals in the queue to Dr. Dolittle. When an animal comes into the office, the doctor examines him, gives prescriptions, appoints tests and may appoint extra examination. Doc knows all the forest animals perfectly well and therefore knows exactly that the animal number i in the queue will have to visit his office exactly ai times. We will assume that an examination takes much more time than making tests and other extra procedures, and therefore we will assume that once an animal leaves the room, it immediately gets to the end of the queue to the doctor. Of course, if the animal has visited the doctor as many times as necessary, then it doesn't have to stand at the end of the queue and it immediately goes home.

Doctor plans to go home after receiving k animals, and therefore what the queue will look like at that moment is important for him. Since the doctor works long hours and she can't get distracted like that after all, she asked you to figure it out.
input: The first line of input data contains two space-separated integers n and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 105, 0 ≤ k ≤ 1014). In the second line are given space-separated integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 109).
Please do not use the %lld specificator to read or write 64-bit numbers in C++. It is recommended to use cin, cout streams (you can also use the %I64d specificator).
output: If the doctor will overall carry out less than k examinations, print a single number "-1" (without quotes). Otherwise, print the sequence of numbers — number of animals in the order in which they stand in the queue.
Note that this sequence may be empty. This case is present in pretests. You can just print nothing or print one "End of line"-character. Both will be accepted.

legend.ai: 有 n 只动物正在排队等待去 Dolittle 医生处就诊。当一只动物进入诊室时，医生会对它进行检查、开具处方、安排检查，并可能安排额外的检查。医生非常了解森林中的所有动物，因此他准确知道，队伍中编号为 i 的动物需要到他的诊室就诊恰好 ai 次。我们假设一次检查所需的时间远多于进行化验和其他额外操作所需的时间，因此假设一只动物离开诊室后，会立即回到医生处队伍的末尾。当然，如果该动物已经按所需次数就诊，那么它就不必排到队尾，而是立即回家。
医生计划在接收 k 只动物后回家，因此那一时刻队列的状态对她来说很重要。由于医生工作时间很长，毕竟不能因此分心，所以她请你计算出队列的状态。

input.ai: 输入数据的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5，0 ≤ k ≤ 10^14）。第二行包含 n 个用空格分隔的整数 a1，a2，...，an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 10^9）。
请不要在 C++ 中使用 %lld 说明符来读写 64 位数字。建议使用 cin、cout 流（也可以使用 %I64d 说明符）。

output.ai: 如果医生总共进行的检查次数少于 k 次，输出一个数字“-1”（不含引号）。否则，输出一个数字序列，即按照动物在队列中的顺序输出它们的编号。
注意，这个序列可能为空。预测试中包含这种情况。你可以什么都不输出，或者只输出一个换行符。两种方式都会被接受。
